_doc: v33 (red): DAY 7 (surprise party). day7_routine.gd / day7_party.gd / day7_bedtime.gd + the shared day4_* code. lines = every EN line of day 7 -> TR (merged into data/extra_lines.json).

breakfast.en: Today is day seven. It's your first week here!
breakfast.tr: Bugün yedinci gün. Burada ilk haftan!

breakfast.en: Can you go to the shop, please? We need some milk.
breakfast.tr: Dükkâna gidebilir misin, lütfen? Biraz süte ihtiyacımız var.

shop.en: I need a bottle of milk.
Hello! What would you like today?
Can I have a bottle of milk, please?
shop.tr: Bir şişe süt alabilir miyim, lütfen?

shop.en: Here you are. That's one pound fifty.

party.en: It is very dark in here.
I am turning on the light.

party.tr: Vay! Benim için bir parti mi?

party.en: Yes! You finished your first week. Congratulations!
Look! These are our photos from this week.
Went, bought, lit: we use the past simple for the past.
party.tr: Went, bought, lit: geçmiş için past simple kullanırız.

party.en: And there is a cake for you!
party.tr: Ve senin için bir pasta var!

evening.en: Put the words in the right order.
Did you know about the party?

evening.puzzle: No, I didn't know about the party.

evening.en: What did you do this week?

evening.puzzle: I learned a lot of English.
My favourite day was day four.
The lights went out and we lit candles.

evening.en: Here is a present for you.
It's a photo album with our photos.
I love it! Thank you for the party.

week.en: A car hit me on the street and I went to the hospital. I learned 'can' and 'should': I should rest.
week.tr: Sokakta bana bir araba çarptı ve hastaneye gittim. 'can' ve 'should' öğrendim: Dinlenmeliyim.

week.q: What did you do on day 2?
week.en: I went to the hospital for a checkup, and then I went to work. I learned 'will', 'going to' and 'have to'.
week.tr: Kontrol için hastaneye gittim, sonra işe gittim. 'will', 'going to' ve 'have to' öğrendim.

week.q: What did you do on day 3?
week.en: I ordered a hot chocolate at the café and I bought apples and milk at the shop. I learned 'how much' and 'how many'.
week.tr: Kafede sıcak çikolata sipariş ettim ve dükkândan elma ile süt aldım. 'how much' ve 'how many' öğrendim.

week.en: There was a power cut! We lit candles and we found a torch. I learned 'there is' and 'there are'.
week.tr: Elektrik kesildi! Mum yaktık ve bir el feneri bulduk. 'there is' ve 'there are' öğrendim.

week.en: A little boy was lost in the shop. I described him and we found his mum. I learned how to describe people and clothes.
week.tr: Dükkânda küçük bir çocuk kaybolmuştu. Onu tarif ettim ve annesini bulduk. İnsanları ve kıyafetleri tarif etmeyi öğrendim.

week.en: There was a big storm and the bus broke down. I learned weather words and 'will'.
week.tr: Büyük bir fırtına vardı ve otobüs bozuldu. Hava durumu kelimelerini ve 'will' öğrendim.

week.en: Today my family had a surprise party for me! I learned the past simple: I had a great week.
week.tr: Bugün ailem bana sürpriz bir parti yaptı! Geçmiş zamanı öğrendim: Harika bir hafta geçirdim.

recap: My family had a party for me.
dream_line: Had, went, shouted: this is the past simple.
